content.short: ShroomDK is an NFT-gated key that gives access to Flipside data.
content.description: ShroomDK delivers comprehensive blockchain data via the Flipside API and a built-in SQL editor, spanning multiple popular chains such as Ethereum, Solana, and Binance Smart Chain. Access to Flipside’s data is granted only after minting a ShroomDK NFT, with each NFT’s traits unlocking different tools and information. This design creates a gamified, developer‑focused experience that tailors the data toolkit to the traits you hold.
